description: Real prices from the DrMaker3D instant quote for three reference parts (a 2 in clip or knob, a 6 in enclosure, an 8 in housing) in each material, at Standard quality, 20% infill, one copy, before shipping. These examples are estimates. For a specific file, use quote_custom_print and follow its quote_status. Also lists the upfront prices for a figure made from a person's photo or AI picture (see figure_from_picture.options for current sizes, colors and prices before shipping), ordered on its own page, and the prices of cake toppers, name keychains and photo lithophanes, each designed on its own page.
